claims.quote: They set the altar small and plain so it could not be mistaken for spectacle: the dented censer in the center, a ring of folded talismans around the smoke, a low lamp to one side.
claims.value: altar set small and plain; dented censer central; ring of folded talismans; low lamp present

claims.quote: "We speak only what we saw. We do not accuse the living for what the dead cannot answer. Each speaker will be given a pebble. Place it where you would place a memory. We repeat each placement aloud and we witness."
claims.value: Elder sets rules: speak only what you saw; no accusing living; pebble placement and witness repetition protocol

claims.quote: Mercy lit a pinch of powdered incense in the dented burner and nodded to the Elder. "We will offer a placation," she said. "We will invite testimony and ask that any naming be given with witnesses. No open talismans until the end."
claims.value: Mercy mediates: offers placation, invites testimony, requests naming only with witnesses, talismans kept closed

claims.quote: Then the fighting began. When one man described a night of hurried removal as an act of mercy, another spat back that it had been cowardice and abandonment. A woman held up the family photograph like an accusation—she said, voice cracked, that she'd once seen the child in that picture near the stairwell—and two others answered, claiming they had seen a different face at that spot. Voices overlaid like film tracks out of sync; the shrine's low ceiling made the overlays a chorus that frayed nerves.
claims.value: residents present conflicting memories and claims; accusations and counterclaims arise; family photo used as contested token

claims.quote: The spirit, which had fed on silence and omission, fed faster on this. A pot on a side shelf clattered and tipped, sloshing a shallow stream of oily water across the floor right beneath the feet of the newest accuser. A talisman, face down, flipped once and skittered toward the man who had just spoken of betrayals as if a hand had nudged it. The censer's smoke thickened and a scent of iron—like the cloth—pulled through the room.
claims.value: spirit amplifies when contradictions arise: causes pot to tip, talisman to flip, smoke thickens, iron scent present

claims.quote: Mercy felt the room close at her ribs—a tightness she steadied against with a steadying breath—and a tremor loosened her words.
claims.value: Mercy experiences anxiety/strain (tight chest, tremor in speech) during placation disturbance; canonical ritual cost not asserted here

claims.quote: "We will not smooth this. Smoothing is forgetting. This thing wants us to forget to keep feeding. We will change the aim. We will witness and name—but we will do so with witnesses, offerings, and careful accounting. We will not shout. We will record what each witness says, we will place marks, and we will hold names with offerings so the spirit cannot claim them as absence."
claims.value: Mercy realizes placation fails; proposes witness-based naming with offerings and careful accounting instead of smoothing

claims.quote: The Circle split in a quiet way that felt louder than the shouting had: half nodded toward Mercy's plan—witnessed naming, small offerings, public accounting; the other half shook their heads, fearful of reprisal and the exposure that names might bring.
claims.value: community split over Mercy's proposed naming ritual vs fear of reprisal

claims.quote: "Names cost," he said softly. "But the city is full of unpaid costs. Bearing them is a duty, and a danger. If we do this, we do it with witnesses and a plan to hold the living through what naming releases."
claims.value: Elder warns names carry cost; insists naming must be with witnesses and plan to support community

claims.quote: The meeting broke with no clear vote. A witness list was begun, names pencilled in Mercy's notebook; some volunteered to stand and bear testimony at a later, witnessed naming; others left quietly with shoulders drawn in.
claims.value: meeting ends without consensus; witness list started; some volunteer for future testimony; some withdraw
